ai.title: SDK adds precomputed project index to skip tree-sitter per run
ai.summary: The SDK exports `ComputedProjectIndex` and `computeProjectIndexFromFiles` so hosts can build a file tree and token scores once per distinct file set. `run.ts` now accepts a `projectIndex` option on `CodebuffClientOptions` and `RunOptions`, passing it to `initialSessionState` and `applyOverridesToSessionState`, where it short-circuits the tree-sitter parse and its CPU and wasm memory cost when `projectFiles` is also present. The index is ignored when `projectFiles` is absent, preserving existing behavior for callers that don't supply it.
ai.evidence: sdk/src/run-state.ts adds `ComputedProjectIndex` and `computeProjectIndexFromFiles`, and `sdk/src/run.ts` threads the new `projectIndex` option through `initialSessionState`, `applyOverridesToSessionState`, and `runOnce`, skipping the tree-sitter parse when `projectFiles` matches.
ai.migration: If you pass `projectFiles` to the SDK `run` call, you may supply the new optional `projectIndex` built via `computeProjectIndexFromFiles` to skip the per-run tree-sitter parse, but existing callers need no changes.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show which SDK client or host will first consume `computeProjectIndexFromFiles` or when the Freebuff web runner will start passing `projectIndex`.
